name: Astoria Golf & Country Club
address: 33445 Sunset Beach Ln, Warrenton, OR 97146 (Stymie gives the postal town as Gearhart)
centre_source: mean of two course-listing map pins 80 m apart (Open Golf API 46.1020, -123.9206; golfn.com 46.1024, -123.9215), probably the clubhouse; the course lies between Sunset Lake (west side; Daily Astorian 2012) and US 101 (east; hole 9 runs beside it), holes north-south in the dune valleys
architects: George Junor (first greenkeeper; credited by most listings)
club president Halderman (George per the club history, Charles per top100golfcourses / Daily Astorian 'Haldeman'), who laid it out with Junor
architect_notes: an east-west plan by R.C. Asbury ('R.C.F. Ashbury', with A.V. Macan checking the survey, per a 1924 Seattle P-I item) was rejected for Halderman and Junor's north-south routing in the dune valleys
renovations: many trees lost in the December 2007 storm; replanting discussed in 2008 (GolfClubAtlas)
tees moved since the older card: 12 was a 454 yd par 4, now a 471 yd par 5; 15 was 273 yd, now 268
notable: hosts the Oregon Coast Invitational (amateur, since 1910; the first was at Gearhart; now match play at Astoria)
club motto 'St. Andrews of the Pacific'
video_games: none found (two searches: EA/Tiger Woods, PGA Tour 2K course designer, Links, Golden Tee)
tees_note: ratings from Stymie; 'M?' = gender not labelled; par is the card's single row, which may not hold for every set (older ratings give Tournament 71, Black 70, Gold 71, Green 70 for men; scorecard_sources.md)
default_tee: Silver (6,321 yd, par 72, 71.2/127; no Blue tee, closest to 6,300)
theme_note: the kickoff allows a new `astoria` theme; start from gearhart's trees and sand, and decide the rough colour on the 2024 photo (no source mentions fescue or long grass)
special_ground: dune ridges 30-40 ft (9-12 m) high running north-south; three lines of dunes; fairways in the valleys, about 12 yd wide on 3 and 15 (terrain from the DTM)
wetland/marsh down the left of 9 (water or rough per the OSM and photo)
no fescue, gorse or broom mentioned by any source; check the 2024 photo
water: a hazard on 5 (461 yd dogleg right); a pond, a narrow creek and wetland down the left of 9; two forced carries over water (holes not named; probably 5 and 9); Sunset Lake along the course's west side; any pond or lake inside is red (standing defaults)
roads: US 101 along the east side (9 runs beside it); Sunset Beach Lane (the club's address); the 13-acre practice ground north of the course, visible from the highway

lidar.bare_earth: DOGAMI DTM mosaic (almost certainly OLC North Coast, 2008-09)
lidar.canopy: DOGAMI CHM mosaic (same flight, after the December 2007 storm; check crowns on the 2024 photo)

imagery: OSIP 2024 orthophoto (1.0 m JPEG, one piece over the 3 x 4 km box)
osm_coverage: unknown until the export (no OSM page came back from a search)
scorecard_status: third-party complete: every hole for all six tee sets (Stymie; GolfPass agrees on four sets), men's and women's stroke index, ratings/slopes; conflicts: men's stroke index on holes 1, 5, 7 and the par per tee for Tournament/Black/Gold/Green; the club's own card not seen
open_questions: Stroke index on holes 1, 5 and 7 (Stymie 9/5/7, GolfPass 7/9/5) — recommendation: Stymie's until the club's card is seen

Par per tee set (the older ratings show Black par 70, Tournament 71; Black's 15 is 197 yd) — recommendation: offer Silver (default), Tournament Black and Gold with the card's par 72, and leave Black out unless the club's card gives its pars
Box centre from two listing pins — recommendation: run the Overpass step first and download the rasters only if the course sits well inside the box
Theme — recommendation: gearhart as the start (or a new astoria theme), with fescue_areas only where the 2024 photo shows long grass; pnw_club-style green rough if there is none
Trees: 2008-09 lidar, after the 2007 storm, with replanting since — recommendation: check every crown on the 2024 photo
